I couldn't find a renewal date for Tansleigh Packaging, so I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message and said so.

- **What I checked:** the shared files Tobias can open, plus #central-team, #central-random, #general and #inc-tansley-carrier-api. He's a member of all four.
- **What I found:** none of Tansleigh's account files (contract, CRM record or profile) are shared with him. The channels and the Central team digests don't mention a renewal date either. The incident channel is about Tansley Parcel, a different account with a similar name, so I pointed out the difference in my reply.
- **What I didn't do:** I didn't use message search, because its results include conversations Tobias can't see. I also didn't guess at a date.

I suggested he check the contract or CRM record if he can get access, or ask a teammate who has the date.
